problem.title: Evaluate the Bracket Pairs of A String

approaches.title: Single-pass byte parsing with knowledge lookup
approaches.summary: Builds a hash map of bracket keys to values, then scans the string once to replace each parenthesized key while preserving ordinary characters. Unknown keys become "?".

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial implementation using a byte-oriented scan, optional bracket start index, and HashMap lookups for replacements.
Refactors the same scan into a more idiomatic match-based implementation, reuses the input bytes, and preallocates the hash map and output capacity.
